summary: Hot October CPI (headline +0.4%, core +0.3%) sent the 2-year yield up about 15 bp to 4.70% and Nasdaq-100 futures down about 1.2% after Monday's 2.4% S&P rally, so the tape leans bearish on growth and tech. Quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from news reports and futures.

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq-100 futures down about 1.2% on hot CPI and a 15 bp jump in 2-year yields after Monday's 3.5% rip; losing 667 opens a fade toward 660.

picks.name: Hims & Hers Health
picks.reason: Q4 revenue guide of $875-895M far below the $955M consensus, EBITDA outlook cut and gross margin down to 57%; a break of $21.50 extends the post-earnings slide.

picks.name: Take-Two Interactive
picks.reason: Up about 3-4% premarket on an EPS beat and GTA VI preorders far above plan with the Nov 19 launch confirmed; a defensive-feeling winner on a red tech day.

picks.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
picks.reason: S&P futures down about 0.5% as hot core CPI revives Waller's half-point hike talk; failing to reclaim Monday's 753 close and losing 746 targets 741.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: After a 13% one-day surge to 508.58 on the Oppenheimer upgrade, it is the most exposed to profit-taking as rate-sensitive tech gaps lower; under 492 targets 482 (price estimated).

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Edged higher premarket after Monday's 4.3% drop to 178.67 on the Huang board probe; a relative-strength bounce through 181.50 can squeeze shorts, but a loss of 175.50 resumes the slide.
